subject: Per-token indexation & commit anchor — proposed CPI cap and pricing bands
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara@nimbusai.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Nimbus AI Procurement <procurement@nimbusai.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing ask — commit tiers + CPI indexation question

Markus — thanks again for the demo last week. Were close to sizing a 12–18 month hosted consumption commitment but procurement has pushed back on open-ended annual per-token increases. Two asks from our side: 

1) Can Redwood accept an annual CPI indexation schedule with a hard cap? Procurement suggested a 3% cap but wed be open to discussing a higher cap if other protections are available.
2) We want some form of an anchor (price floor/ceiling) or a pre-agreed tiered per-token table tied to committed QPS/volume. That helps our FP&A model.

Wed also like clarity on MFN language — Nimbus wants parity with comparable committed customers but we also understand youre cautious. Can you propose a practical compromise?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

— Sara Liu
Head of Platform Partnerships
Nimbus AI
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Sara Liu <sara@nimbusai.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing ask — commit tiers + CPI indexation question

Sara — appreciate the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes on a capped CPI indexation, and yes we can provide tiered per-token bands tied to committed spend/usage. MFN requests are common; we typically narrow the scope to equivalent service/product and commit tier.

Ill loop in Monica (finance) and Karthik (sales ops) to put together a concise counterproposal with concrete numbers and some fallback language (price floor/ceiling + optional mid-term review). Are you available Wed 7th at 10am PT to review the draft MAP?

Next steps I propose:
- Redwood drafts a 1-page term sheet with: commit tiers, per-token rates, annual CPI indexation formula + cap, MFN carve-out language, and a simple floor/ceiling construct.
- Nimbus reviews and we iterate.

If that sounds good Ill circulate the draft today.

Best,
Markus Klein
Sr. Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Pricing ask — prep notes

Markus / Karthik — drafting notes below for the term sheet. Key constraints from finance:

- CPI indexation: open to annual CPI adjustment but limit to max 4% year-over-year (we can offer 3% for higher commits).
- Price floor: to protect our base economics, set a floor at 80% of initial per-token for life of the commitment.
- Price ceiling: allow a cap equal to floor + CPI cap (i.e., floor * (1 + CPI cap)). This keeps math simple.
- MFN: Accept MFN limited to published per-token pricing for customers with equivalent committed ARR and comparable usage profile; exclude promotional/short-term pilots.
- Commitment bands: propose three tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with stepped per-token prices tied to monthly committed tokens.

Draft terms to include an optional 6-month mid-term price review if actual usage deviates >25% from forecast — limited to renegotiation of future months only, not retroactive.

Ill assemble the spreadsheet with suggested numbers and send by EOD.

— Monica
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Sara Liu <sara@nimbusai.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pricing ask — commit tiers + CPI indexation question

Sara — attaching a short Mutual Action Plan and a term-sheet summary for your review (attachments: Nimbus-MAP-draft.pdf; Redwood-Commit-Term-Sheet.xlsx). Highlights: 

- Commit duration: 12 months (option to extend to 18 months for an expanded discount).
- Tiers (monthly committed tokens): Bronze 0–250M, Silver 250M–1B, Gold 1B+.
- Per-token list price and tiered discounts included in spreadsheet; Gold example: $0.0008/token (baseline) with a floor at 80% ($0.00064) and CPIannual cap 3% for Gold; Silver/ Bronze get 3%/4% cap respectively per Monicas suggestion.
- MFN: Redwood will provide MFN parity only for customers with >= same committed ARR and similar sustained QPS; MFN excludes one-time promotional credits and marketplace bundle pricing.
- Mid-term review: at 6 months if usage varies by >25% we do a forward-looking adjustment; no retroactive price changes.

Please review and tell us which tier youre targeting and whether the CPI caps work for you. If Nimbus prefers a single uniform CPI cap (e.g., 3% across tiers) we can discuss tradeoffs to price.

Call to action: confirm Wed 7th slot? (I know dates shifted — happy to move)

Regards,
Markus Klein
Sr. Director, Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Liu <sara@nimbusai.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Nimbus AI Procurement <procurement@nimbusai.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing ask — commit tiers + CPI indexation question

Markus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. Procurement reviewed the term sheet and we have feedback: 

- Nimbus is comfortable targeting Silver (estimated 700M tokens / month) but we need the CPI cap to be uniform at 3% across tiers to get procurement sign-off. They wont accept higher caps on lower tiers.
- MFN: Nimbus will accept the equivalent-commit ARR carve-out but asks that MFN be evaluated on a rolling 12-month lookback rather than on published price alone.
- Price floor: Procurement accepts 80% floor but asks for a maximum 24-month stability window for the floor to avoid long tails.

Can Redwood confirm acceptance of: uniform 3% annual CPI cap, MFN with 12-month rolling parity check, and 24-month floor stability? If yes well circulate signatures and procurement will attach the SOW.

If helpful, procurement is happy to jump on a 30-min call Monday morning PT to finalize.

— Sara
Head of Platform Partnerships
Nimbus AI
